## Summary

**1. Deployed checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions**

- Incident **INC-0001** created, recording the hotfix deployment of v2.3.2 to all production regions to address the unhealthy v2.3.1 release. The on-call engineer was paged as part of the incident creation.
